What was decided by hand (MANUAL, 38)

  • Lantern Lane keeps its path (g_rocket, e_sw, e_se, g_satellite); its south arm moves from y -600 to -490, the sheet's south edge being the old Southside's (-506)
  • Crown Circus: island r 14, the ring road 14–29 (old 14–26: 3 m wider so the tram's terminal loop runs on R 25 with its swept envelope, ±1.825, inside the carriageway, and its transitions clear the boulevard mouth's kerb returns), the walk ring to the crescents at r 35 (old)
  • The Handover zone's eight streets keep their ids, paths and widths (rocket-lane, starline-street, garden-row, orbit-walk, pylon-row, apron-road, satellite-street, lantern-lane); Market Street keeps its id, its line and the gates on it, and becomes a tram street (w 19, no median)
  • lamplight-south-w and lamplight-south-e (in the walk window) and lamplight-west stay as today with today's neighbours on every edge (Lamplight Lane at y -120, lamplight-east north of -e, boulevard-west south of it, the garden walk): their edge classes, buildings and building lines are byte-identical, so the sim site (grid and occluders) and the takedown places are unchanged and the Handover's replays stand. The old town gives way: the boulevard's west wall between Starline Street and y -126 is lamplight-south-e (today's massing), the old W2 starts at -126, the gardens at -114
  • The east lane (old z 134–140) and the west lane (old z 2–8, on the line of Starline Street) are passages through one plot each (east-wall: old E2 and E3; west-wall: old W1 and W2); old Sunset Way west of the boulevard is the west wall plot's south flags, so the Handover's streets never join the boulevard's
  • Orbit Gardens are trimmed at the Handover zone's edge (y -148, old z 58): the old lawns, canal and west terrace south of it (old z -40..58) are the Handover zone's; the canal runs from y -148 to -16.6, the pool at (-78, 0), the pavilion at (-101, -110)
  • The old west terrace (one 286 m wall facing the gardens at x -110, its back to the procedural massing) is one 28 m deep block south of the Gardens Gate at x -138..-110 (terrace-s, fronting Lamplight Lane, the garden walk at its back; the grammar wants 28 back to back, so its back faces Orbit Row); its 37 m north of the gate is lawn (gardens-n), where S1 turns north
  • West Row (the strip x -460..-352 west of Sunset Way, the first remap's beyond hatch): an access street on x -416 from Circus Road (gate west-row-gate) south to y -548; 8 m lanes at y -432, -312, -192, -126 (opposite the seams of Sunset Way's east-side plots -192, -126, and each span cut into the fewest equal blocks of at most 140 m); 5 plots each side fitted by the grammar (west residential, east mixed), the last west plot running on to Circus Road as the corner block; Western Park (east of West Row, where S1's station banks stand) runs on north to Crown Road. The beyond hatch keeps only the sheet's slivers
  • Southside trimmed: the Handover zone is where the old world sited the Handover too (its N4 and W2), and Satellite Street and the Records Office stand on old W1, N1's west half and the Rocket Lane diagonal (RL1, RL2, RB1), which go; Orbit Square keeps its east and west halves either side of the boulevard, which runs through it to the south edge (old Comet Row ended on the square)
  • The Gardens Gate (old: the circus's west gate promenade to the pool, 12 m) is an 18 m mall from Orbit Row to the circus walk ring: S1's pylons stand on it where it leaves Circus Road
  • Crown Parade is an 18 m walk on the circus axis to the quay (old: the wedge between the crescents, 24 m at the circus widening to 56 at the terrace): the crescents' 14 m bands, which end ±12 m off the axis, need the plots to reach ±9
  • The harbour: the upper terrace (x 46–74), steps and promenade (to 96) are one quay strip down the whole sheet (old z -300..380, run on to both edges); the sea from x 96; the Skyport Pier on the axis to its apron, the Market Pier (old z 60–76) to the liner berth
  • The tram: the old line ran on the boulevard's west lane from Sunset Way to short of the circus, one track (old TrackX -2.5), one stop island (old z 100–124). The plan's rules want double track in the centre lanes, a loop at an end inside the sheet and stops 300–500 m apart: T1 runs the boulevard (stop "Crown Circus" at y -64, the old island's place) and turns on a loop round the circus island on the ring road (R 25), and its other end runs Market Street and Sunset Way to the West End, joining the sky rail at both ends; no overhead wires (TS-W0)
  • The plan's S1 (Sphere Line) is not an old line: the generator lays station banks only for east-west lines on y 0 (the circus axis), so S1 runs from the West End along Circus Road (Western Park and Orbit Gardens stations), north past the Sphere's east side (x -95) and off the sheet; it joins T1 at Sunset Terraces. No line reaches the Skyport (a station there would have to be 200–500 m from another on y 0, and the circus's 14 m island takes no pylon). The old lines stay planned data:
  • The old lines are not in plan.skyrail in this draft: the generator lays station banks for east-west lines only and the old lines run north-south (the main loop over the boulevard's west promenade, x -13; the harbour line on the quay, x 88). S1 (Sphere Line: Circus Road, north on x -218, a loop by the Sphere) and S2 (Harbour Line: up the quay, into the Skyport Tower, round the pad) are planned in oldtown.skyrail.planned with radii, spans and stations, ready for plan.skyrail once the generator lays north-south banks (Splice). The old boulevard leg also needs a pylon zone on the promenade (pylonZones has none) and is drawn as data only
  • The harbour sky rail (planned) keeps the old quay leg (x 88) and Harbour station (old (88, 110) → plan (88, -96), here 44 m south at -140 so the station spacing to the Skyport holds, 200 m); the old loop round the Skyport (R 48) becomes the plan's line into the Skyport Tower's portal (the tower 15 m east of the old Skyport, x 170 → 170, so the R 70 turn off the quay ends before the portal) and the loop round the pad beyond; the old sea leg (x 122) is not built (the line ends on its loop)
  • The Sphere stands at the old SphereStation (old (-130, 330) → plan (-130,124), yaw 20) at the plan's ×0.425 (top 80, Aster review 2026-10-12); the old town stood it at ×1 (188 m)
  • The Skyport is the old Skyport_Tower piece at the old position (plan (170, 0)) as a landmark at 108 m (× 0.94), not today's Skyport Tower megastructure: that portal tower needs a sky line and its station through it, and no line the generator can build reaches the pier (S2 planned); the aircar pad landmark goes (the tower carries the old discs)
  • The liner berth closes old Market Street's vista at the Market Pier's head (old LinerDock at x 270 on the pier's axis; plan (270,-138), the pier 152 m long)
  • The gate towers (old DiscTower pair at x ±44, z 372) stand at the old 156.6 (× 1.0, tip 156.8): within 150 m of the quay, so standards.skyline.harbour.exceptions names the pair (brief 075 remap, Aster); every other tip there keeps 108
  • The ParabolicArch across Crown Avenue (old (0, 250) → plan (0, 44)) stands as landmarks[disc-west].gateway: its plinths (x ±14–17, y 41–47) in the avenue's frontage zone, which here runs to the old walls' building line at |x| 18 (K-1, Splice's measure, briefs/075/notes.md)
  • The old SkyBridge between the gate towers (60 m up) is in oldtown.props, not placed: no plan structure carries it yet
  • SpaceHQ: at the old position (plan (0, 244)), closing the axis; its drum keeps the regenerated SpaceHQ_Portal but carries no beam (portalWas): the plan's signature portal reads a line on y 0, and the old main loop turned west before the HQ
  • Lantern Terraces (a second terraced-housing megastructure, Crown Terraces' kind) on lantern-court, facing south over Lantern Lane: MS-1 keeps 2–4 megastructures and the old town's only one (the Skyport) cannot be today's portal tower without a sky line
  • Crown Terraces (megastructure) move to the West Terraces plot (x -244..-164, y -114..-45) facing south over Lamplight Lane, keeping MS-1's 2–4: the old town had procedural massing there (DecoKitCityMass); no bridges
  • T1's stops: Sunset Terraces (-340, 131, the S1 interchange) and Crown Circus (0, -68, the old island's place) fixed; Lamplight, Rocket and Orbit Square at equal chainage between them (300.38 m)
  • Kerb faces (streetscape.roads.kerbs): the circus mouths of the Boulevard and Crown Avenue, and the mouths of the garden walk, the west lane, the Sunset Walk, the Gardens Gate and the Sphere Walk on their roads, recomputed for the old town; the Handover's (garden walk on Starline Street) kept. The crossing coverage's hand removals named today's crossings: cleared (the rules still apply)
  • towers.sites: none. The old town has no frontage towers on the composed district (its towers were Southside podium towers, DecoKitHighrise, and background towers up the coast, oldtown.props.towers); every live site named a plot that is gone
  • The Crown Vista tower (250 m, standards.skyline.vista) goes: the old axis closes on the SpaceHQ through the arch, between the two DiscTowers, as the old reel
  • Frontage mixes for the new areas from today's: the Boulevard takes the Crescent Quarter's, Crown Circus the Records Precinct's, Southside, West Row (Southside's spirit, brief 075 follow-up) and the West Terraces Sphere Gardens' (their faces on squares and greens), the garden terrace Lamplight's, the Lantern Quarter and the harbour keep theirs
  • W2 starts at y -126 (old -198: the west lane), north of lamplight-south-e: 12 bays off its south end (old civic hall run S6 2, H 12 → H 2), its garden wall the same
  • W2's garden wall (old: End, Corner at z 178) ends square here: its corner cell at the crescent's back had no perpendicular run (BG-2); 27 bays from the lane as old
  • W4 and E4's boulevard walls end on their short walls at y 140 (old: they started at CircusNorth 236.017 and ran 110 m, 1.7 cm past the short walls at 346); their garden and terrace walls (old: a corner at z 234 meeting no run) start one cell on with an end
  • E1: 11 bays (old 13, 2 off its south segment), between the plan's 6.5 m pavements on Sunset Way and Market Street (y -234.5..-152.5; old -242..-148)
  • E2: 7 bays (old 8), from Market Street's building line to the east lane (y -122..-72; old -128..-72)
  • E3's terrace wall (old: End, Corner at z 178, the parade's corner) ends square: no perpendicular run meets that corner (BG-2)
  • Blocks: the boulevard walls, their short walls and the four crescents are the old walls exactly (start, length, caps, segments and storey classes; plan.blocks[].runs[].segs and .old). Every other laid plot (the garden terrace, Southside, the Lantern Quarter) is fitted by the grammar to its building line, its long faces on the higher-rank street; their classes are left to the generator (Splice) where no old block stood
  • Timetable: T1 and S1 runs regenerated stop to stop at today's speeds; journeys cleared (they named T2 and today's stops) for Pulse
